headlines.title: Airbnb vs. Coupang: Which Consumer Stock Is a Better Buy in 2026?
headlines.summary: Airbnb's 20% net margin and capital-light model contrast sharply with Coupang's razor-thin 0.6% margin and heavy logistics costs. Which operational model wins in 2026?

headlines.title: Here's What to Expect From Airbnb's Next Earnings Report
headlines.summary: Airbnb is scheduled to report its third-quarter results next month, and analysts expect a double-digit earnings growth.

headlines.title: Airbnb vs. Coupang: Cyclical Volatility vs. Steady Scale in Revenue
headlines.summary: Coupang's revenue runs 2.5x to 3x higher than Airbnb's, with minimal seasonal swings -- a stark contrast to Airbnb's predictable boom-bust cycle.

headlines.title: Airbnb vs. Chewy: Do Pets or Places Power One Stock More than the Other?
headlines.summary: Airbnb boasts a 20% net margin and fortress balance sheet, while Chewy's pharmacy expansion offers growth but carries regulatory complexity.

description: Airbnb, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates a platform for stays, experiences, and services worldwide. The company's marketplace connects hosts and guests online or through mobile devices to book spaces, experiences, and services. It also offers gift cards. The company was formerly known as AirBed & Breakfast, Inc. and changed its name to Airbnb, Inc. in November 2010. Airbnb, Inc. was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.
